entries.title: Crystal Grain Boundary Growth in a Cooling Metal Block
entries.description: A transparent cube with many small colored lattice spheres that slowly align into ordered regions, forming sharp moving grain boundaries where misaligned atoms pulse, shift, and occasionally detach as the block cools and labels track boundary positions.

entries.title: Cell Membrane Self-Assembly from Floating Lipid Molecules
entries.description: Hundreds of tiny two-colored “lollipop” lipids float in a watery box, spontaneously aligning and snapping together into a flexible bilayer sheet that bends, wraps, and seals to form a closed cell boundary with semi-transparent membrane and diffusing particles outside.
